descricao_original: This longitudinal view of compact, lamellar bone shows numerous, vertically-oriented Haversian canals and their interconnecting Volkmann’s canals. Haversian systems are oriented parallel to the long axis of the diaphysis; Volkmann’s canals are oriented mostly in a transverse plane. Ground compact bone, 200x
creditos_identificados: Image source: This image was taken of a slide in the University of Michigan collection.
